## Frozen decision rule

Fullness within 3 tiles of home, H ÷ C: discovery 0.970, holdout 0.976; food per forage action lower in H: discovery yes, holdout yes.

**Not confirmed.** The hunger has another cause; HB2 is not designed until it is found.
